attributes.name: hand_to_mouth_or_nose
attributes.text: A hand comes to the front of the mouth or nose.
attributes.definition: At least one hand tip or wrist ends at or just in front of the mouth or nose, centered on the face, and stays there for at least a short moment.

attributes.name: hand_to_ear_region
attributes.text: A hand comes to the side of the head next to the ear.
attributes.definition: A hand ends beside the head at ear height, lateral to the face rather than in front of it.

attributes.name: hand_on_top_of_head
attributes.text: A hand rests on or moves over the top of the head.
attributes.definition: A hand reaches the crown of the head, above the level of the ears, and touches or nearly touches it.

attributes.name: hand_to_forehead_or_temple
attributes.text: A hand touches the forehead or the temple.
attributes.definition: A hand ends at the upper part of the face, above the eyes, at the front or at the side of the forehead.

attributes.name: hands_touch_each_other
attributes.text: The two hands of the same person meet and touch.
attributes.definition: The left and right hand joints come into contact or nearly so in front of the body for at least part of the action.

attributes.name: forearms_cross
attributes.text: The two forearms cross over each other in front of the body.
attributes.definition: Each hand ends on the opposite side of the body midline so the forearms overlap in front of the chest or face.

attributes.name: hand_on_own_chest_or_belly
attributes.text: A hand presses on the front of the own chest or belly.
attributes.definition: A hand rests on the front surface of the torso, between the shoulders and the hips, and stays there.

attributes.name: hand_at_own_hip_or_back
attributes.text: A hand goes to the side of the hip or behind the lower back.
attributes.definition: A hand ends at the outside of the hip, the upper thigh, or behind the torso near the waist.

attributes.name: hand_to_own_foot
attributes.text: A hand reaches down to touch the own foot or ankle.
attributes.definition: A hand comes to the foot or ankle joint of the same person, which requires the torso to bend or the leg to lift.

attributes.name: head_moves_to_hand
attributes.text: The head bends toward a raised hand to close the gap.
attributes.definition: While a hand is held near the face, the head moves forward or down toward it rather than only the hand moving to the head.
